“Let’s just sleep. Together.”
Nothing else.
Just bodies intertwining.
Seo-yeon requested it, and Do-jun willingly accepted.

77046.synopsis:
He had dreamed of freedom his entire life, but in an instant, he lost that freedom.
Embracing despair over the freedom he had lost right before his eyes, he fell into the abyss.
“What is this luxurious room? What is this young body?”
It feels strangely unsettling.
No way, it couldn’t possibly be that side, could it?
“The Heavenly Demon Cult is invincible, all demons submit. I congratulate the Third Young Master on his recovery.”
“…Heavenly what?”
Cheon Ha-jin, the secret weapon of the Righteous Faction Alliance, reincarnates as Seo Ryang, the Third Young Master of the Heavenly Demon Cult.
“I need to escape!”
associated_names: ตำนานการเกิดใหม่ในลัทธิมาร

77302.synopsis:
After crossing the world, he has now reclaimed his life as a person named “Sherlock Forrest”, an exceptional graduate from Hogwarts. Right after he was thrown into this wizarding world, he immediately got a letter that he was appointed to be the next Defense Against Dark Arts professor in Hogwarts in the 2nd year.
But he had just crossed to this world and he barely knew how to use cast magic, especially he knew very well that this position is widely believed to be “Cursed”. There’s no way for him to escape in this situation, he takes the role and does his best.
Though, one thing that Sherlock doesn’t know is that, danger lingers around. So many unknown things that are unexplainable are coming toward him. The Order, The Birthmark, His Mother and everything. What does it mean? He will find out the answer.
associated_names: Just a Defense Against the Dark Arts Professor
不过是黑魔法防御课教授罢了

78838.synopsis:
The hero of the kingdom and the leader of the demon slayer squad, Valen, tries to save a woman from being attacked by a demon beast in the middle of a battlefield, only to be struck from behind…
It turns out the woman was not a civilian but a succubus!
When Valen regains consciousness, he finds himself not on the bloody battlefield but in a wedding hall in the demon realm.
“I am Argen. And you are?”
“Do you think I’d give my name to a filthy demon?”
The war-weary demons propose a marriage alliance to him. The terms of this outlandish deal last until the succubus Argen, whom Valen saved, becomes pregnant.
The thought of having a child with a demon disgusts him, but Valen, driven to the brink, ultimately accepts their proposal.
“Let’s drop the pretense and get this over with. It will be easier for both of us.”
“I want to give you time to accept this.”
“Do I have to give my heart as well as my body? Will that strengthen your power?”
Disgusted by the demons’ hypocrisy and the idea of a succubus desiring his body, Valen plans to leave the demon realm without looking back once Argen is pregnant.
“Call me or come find me yourself.”
“……”
“I’ll give you my best effort to strengthen your power.”
Can the human hero Valen, who detests demons, and the Demon King Argen, who wants peace through pregnancy, bring peace to the demon realm?

79094.synopsis:
Su Zhi transmigrated into the body of a farmer’s wife who had just been married. 
She was both sick and unattractive, and her in-laws and parents’ families were hell bent on making things exceptionally difficult for her. 
Luckily, her husband was very caring, and heaven had also granted her a pond with a spiritual spring and seven immortal lotuses, allowing her to lead an increasingly prosperous life!
associated_names: The Farmer's Wife Lingquan has a bit of farmland.
The peasant woman Lingquan has a bit of farmland.

80374.synopsis:
Qin Ming relied on tenacious perseverance to cultivate the body of the legendary Pill God, and at the most critical moment, he was harmed by the closest person.
Unexpectedly, he regressed back to his childhood..
With this second chance, he will not only resolutely take revenge, but also become a Peerless Warrior!

83446.synopsis:
This is a story about a heartless and insane younger brother who takes the dominant role. And a self-deprecating and miserable older brother who takes the submissive role.
After ten years, Song Jin returns to the Song family main house, where Song Xinglan, his younger brother, mostly says to him: “Song Jin, you’re disgusting.”
Early Stage: Insane Beastly Dominant younger brother X Calmly Suffering Submissive older brother
Mid-term Stage: The Insane Dominant younger brother turns into a Foolish Crybaby Dominant and the Urban Setting Turns into Rural Setting
Later Stage: (Possibly) Wife Chasing Crematorium

84982.synopsis: Suddenly I was left to raise a half-elf baby

85238.synopsis:
“I don’t want to have you as my little brother. With that said, it doesn’t mean that I don’t like you.”
Song Yewoon entered Ji Cheonghyeon’s mansion as his mother remarried.
Now stepbrothers, the two continued to meet secretly in Cheonghyeon’s study, becoming more conscious of each other and closing the distance between them.
Yewoon grew up feeling like an outsider in the world while his mother ab*sed him at home.
In the space Cheonghyeon gave him, he felt like he wasn’t an intruder for the first time.
Little by little, his wounds began to heal.

86774.synopsis:
One day, the Crown Prince of the Empire suddenly fell ill. Despite the efforts of all the Empire’s physicians, the Crown Prince’s condition only worsened. The Emperor fell into deep despair. At that moment, an oracle was delivered.
[The Crown Prince will be cured if he drinks the milk of Sir Kedrick Lachenov.]
Kedrick Lachenov. Known as the guardian of the royal family, the Commander Knight of Lexion. Without hesitation, he accepted the oracle.
“I am Kedrick Luthens of the Lachenov family and the Commander of the Knights of Lexion. As long as my loyalty to the royal family remains unchanged, I will gladly offer my life if asked.”
Kedrick was subsequently imprisoned in the temple’s underground and subjected to various methods of inducing lactation. Until milk began to flow from his chest.
“…When will I be able to go back?” 
“Why are you asking me that, Kedrick? You should be asking your own chest.”
Lewis l**ked his thin lower lip, anticipating Kedrick’s face, twisted in shame and near tears.
“Thinking about you begging and crying to have your chest touched is so exciting… it’s driving me crazy.”
The golden eyes, once fiercely shining like a wild beast, became moist and distorted. Each time Kedrick gasped for air, his large chest swayed.
“Isn’t this all for His Highness the Crown Prince?”
associated_names: You Became a Public Good, Sir

88054.synopsis:
Lin Ling is a little mushroom spirit growing on the beam of the Imperial study, and every day, he watches the tyrant’s daily routine—confiscating property, exile, and executing the nine clans.
The little mushroom has no particular opinion about this, except that the small flower pot he uses to bask in the moonlight always gets innocently implicated, along with memorials that are smashed to the ground.
So, he enters the tyrant’s dreams daily to complain, and the tyrant gives him a new flower pot in return.
Lin Ling was on the beam, looking at his newly acquired flower pot, and was happily imagining moving in when the tyrant got angry again.
The moment the tyrant raised his hand, Lin Ling immediately and nervously whispered, “When you get angry and start smashing things later, please don’t break my new flower pot again, okay?”
The hall instantly fell silent, and under everyone’s gaze, the tyrant turned around and moved the flower pot to a different location.
The ministers, who trembled in fear and dared not take another glance, belatedly realized that the ruthless emperor was also learning how to take care of a soft, small mushroom.
One-sentence summary: The Tyrant and His Adorable Mushroom Demon Concubine Theme: You need to work hard to get what you want.
associated_names: Tips for an Emperor on How to Care for a Mushroom
帝王养蘑菇的注意事项

88310.synopsis:
Tong Yang, on a whim, joins a gossip group created two years in the future. The group members share fresh gossip daily, like a certain actress dying tragically, a rich merchant’s son mysteriously disappearing, or a passenger plane crashing with all crew and passengers dead…
 However, as far as Tong Yang knows: the actress’s career is thriving, receiving rave reviews; the rich merchant’s son is attending a private elite school, guarded 24/7 by bodyguards; the mysteriously crashed plane is still in testing, with no passenger experience.
 Initially, she didn’t take it seriously, treating it as a distraction from her boring life. Until one day, she had a flash of inspiration and asked if there was any information about her future.
 After a minute of silence, a group member sent a news link: “Genius from a Poor Family, Tong Yang, Dies Ten Days Before College Entrance Exam Due to Home Invasion Robbery. Teacher Says: She Could Have Been the Top Science Student in the Province!”
 Tong Yang was stunned, looking up at the calendar. It was May 28th, exactly ten days before the exam! Meanwhile, clear footsteps echoed in the hallway on that quiet midnight…
 The next day, the group exploded.
 [Whoa? That news link is gone?] 
 [I remember it was a big deal, even my parents knew, but when I asked, they said they don’t remember!] 
 [Seriously?? Don’t scare me??] 
 Tong Yang: “To be honest, I’m from 2024, name’s Tong Yang.”
 [???] 
 [Whoa, no way?? Two years ago??] 
 [Folks, here’s our chance to get rich! The next lottery numbers are…] 
 [Wait, what about the home invasion robber?] 
 Tong Yang: “Guess.”

89334.synopsis:
“You crazy bastard! Why did you kill our party members?!”
Ieon, who prefers taking it easy with small quests, somehow ended up in a party with the high-ranking player “Raham.”
Raham, whose skills are undeniably overwhelming, suddenly wiped out their entire party, saying they were too noisy.
And this psycho is our Guild Master?
Unlike their first encounter where Raham tried to kill him, he now follows Ieon around, offering to help with quests. While suspicious of Raham’s motives, Ieon eventually warms up to the convenience of being carried by a high-level player. They even become close enough to meet offline for meals…
“You know what they say? Paladin and Demon Priest are a perfect match.”
Hold on, what?
I didn’t mean to get this close!
* * *
Still unable to process the situation, Ieon could only blink. The man tilted his head slightly as he watched him.
“Strange.”
“…?”
His low voice was oddly calm, not fitting for their current situation. Ieon tore his gaze away from the corpses lying at their feet and looked at the man.
“Aren’t you the Tiog Paladin?”
“…Yes.”
At Ieon’s cautious answer, the man’s lips curved into a smile.
“But why aren’t you dead?”
…What?

90614.synopsis:
Lu Ran is the neglected biological son of a wealthy family.
When he was four years old, he got lost. Upon returning home, his family favored the adopted son, Shen Xingran, ignoring the difficulties Shen Xingran imposed on him. In fact, to spare Shen Xingran from feeling upset or embarrassed, they kept Lu Ran’s true identity a secret.
At first, Lu Ran couldn’t accept this treatment and fought desperately against the adopted son. Eventually, however, he was pushed into the pool during winter by Shen Xingran, damaging his joints at a young age.
The members of the Shen family watched this unfold but remained indifferent.
Lu Ran’s heart turned to ashes; he no longer sought his family’s affection and resolutely left the wealthy household.
Yet, the Shen family and Shen Xingran continued to harass him. They pressured him in various ways, forcing him to be as grateful as a dog for the scraps of mercy from the wealthy family, leaving him with no place to hide.
While escaping from his family, Lu Ran got into a car accident and became completely paralyzed, confined to a hospital room for a full ten years.
In a moment of rebirth, he learned that he was merely a cannon fodder character in a wealthy family pampering novel, with the true protagonist being the adopted son, Shen Xingran.
Lu Ran suddenly came to a realization.
What was he hiding for? He was living a miserable life, so why should he let the Shen family have it easy?
Thus, he began to go wild…
His biased parents launched a tirade against him at the dinner table. Lu Ran kicked over all the dishes and smashed a dog’s feces onto the table, shouting, “If you’re not going to eat, then nobody eats!”
Rich kids tried to make things difficult for him. Lu Ran brandished a toilet brush and thrust it toward someone’s mouth, saying, “If you don’t want to be human, then I’ll give you a different kind of food.”
The Shen family wanted to kick him out of the house. Lu Ran simply grabbed a sleeping bag and lay down at the entrance of the Shen residence.
Come on, let’s see who can outlast whom.
…
In an instant, Lu Ran became the most feared person in the wealthy circles of the capital.
Some were puzzled, wondering how a seemingly helpless Lu Ran dared to act this way.
At a banquet, they spotted the neglected young master nestled in the wheelchair of the Ji family head.
The rumored gloomy and aloof Ji Min carefully held the sleeping boy in his arms, gently covering him with a thin blanket to keep him warm.
When an unobservant person approached to greet them, the man immediately made a shushing gesture, his gaze cold and serious.
People could only sigh, believing he must be deeply in love with Lu Ran.
Little did they know, this cold and domineering figure, who had long held power and was used to getting his way, was secretly thinking:
It took so much effort to get him to sleep.
If he wakes up, who can stand it…?
One-sentence summary: They are all scared.
Theme: Only by having self-respect and self-love can one earn the respect of others.
associated_names: Vật Hi Sinh Nhà Quyền Quý Bắt Đầu Nổi Điên

90870.synopsis:
In the book, Yun Zhuoran is described as an immortal beauty, cold and ethereal, a disciple of the greatest cultivator under the Heavenly Dao. He is also destined to form a Dao bond with his senior brother, Shen Lingshu, who possesses an innate Dao bone—a match made in heaven, the pinnacle of success.
However, Shen Lingshu, his seemingly perfect senior brother, is actually the protagonist of the story, cultivating the “Emotionless Great Dao of Taishang” technique. After their marriage, Shen Lingshu will heartlessly “kill his wife to achieve Dao,” paving his smooth path toward ascension. Along the way, he will gather a harem that includes a young disciple and the Demon Palace’s heir. In the end, Shen Lingshu will ascend to immortality.
As for Yun Zhuoran, in this book, he’s nothing more than a disposable tool, a foolish, venomous vase—the original wife doomed to be discarded.
Closing the book, Yun Zhuoran observes his always dignified and jade-like senior brother and indeed hears his proposal. At the same time, a frantic voice sounds in his ear:
“Brother, don’t believe Shen Lingshu! He just wants to deceive you and take your life!”
Yun Zhuoran: ……
A few days earlier, under the dark rolling clouds, Yun Zhuoran had just emerged from the lighting tribulation when he met another version of himself for the first time—
At first glance, Yun Zhuoran’s heart demon, who had manifested, sees his famously beautiful face, flawless as the rumors say. In an instant, all the demon’s menacing aura vanishes. With a dramatic flop, it falls at Yun Zhuoran’s feet, exclaiming: “Oh no, little heart demon has fallen! I need a kiss and a hug from brother to get back up!”
#What do I do when my heart demon loves me too much? (just kidding)#
#Raising a heart demon in the righteous path#
If I don’t work hard, I’ll have to return to Penglai and inherit the immortal island (?).
The beautiful and cold shou
【Lively and adorable little sweet heart demon gong】
——————————————————
Main character + heart demon, selfcest (top and bottom are the same person), mutual pampering.
Strong shou, with overpowered abilities, beautiful yet tragic + adored by everyone. Slow burn. The gong is initially a clingy, spoiled little demon, but the romance develops later.
Cultivation levels in the story: Qi Refining → Foundation Establishment → Golden Core → Nascent Soul → Out-of-Body → Deity Transformation (Split Deity) → Integration → Great Ascension → Ascension (Not a traditional xianxia, with a lot of custom settings).
Ps. The plot leans towards story-driven rather than fast-paced action. Not marked as fluff or power fantasy. If you want to subscribe, take your time reading chapter by chapter.

91382.synopsis:
Lu Fei transmigrated into a parallel world and started working at a top financial company, unlocking the “God-Level Investor System.”
Each week he completed at work, Lu Fei would receive various system rewards:
Top-tier financial knowledge, a perfect physique, cash…
One day after work, Lu Fei found a stray cat.
From that moment on, all of his decisions were suddenly executed by the company’s upper management.
Stock prices fell, and the company avoided a crisis.
Stock prices soared, and the company just happened to buy in.
Something didn’t seem right!
Lu Fei realized there was an insider close to him.
Until one day, during a board meeting, the CEO Xu Yan suddenly walked up to him, sat on his lap, and asked for head pats.
Uh… well…
It looks like the insider has been found.
associated_names: 惊了！我家猫居然是女总裁变的

91638.synopsis: There is a small island in the East Sea, elongated in shape, wider in the east and narrower in the west. The island is lush with vegetation, with interconnected courtyards, rock gardens, and ponds. Magnificent buildings with flying eaves adorn the landscape, while a flock of white cranes circles high in the sky. From a distance, the entire island resembles a giant gourd, hence the name Huludao (Gourd Island). On this island resides a Han family that practices cultivation, and the story begins here.

92150.synopsis:
Betrayed by her ex-boyfriend, Seo-a decides to drown her sorrows in alcohol. After getting completely drunk, she blacked out. When she finally regains consciousness, she finds herself n*ked in a hotel room with the sound of water nearby.
“Excuse me, would you consider marrying me when you have time?”
Startled by the sudden flood of memories, she tried to escape but was caught.
“It wouldn’t be good for you to run away.”
“Run away? I don’t know what you’re talking about! I really have to go!”

92406.synopsis:
Novels always have these cannon fodder female supporting characters. Beautiful, foolish, and self-destructive. They steal men, harm the protagonist, steal the golden finger, and persecute the down-and-out big boss… They jump around repeatedly, afraid that they won’t die fast enough, and end up with a tragic fate of dying young. 
Su Wan finds herself in their shoes, only wanting to live a peaceful and leisurely life, and to pass away peacefully in each world. 
As a result, the world changes. 
The domineering CEO: “Stop entangling with me, I will never love you!” Su Wan: “The secret to maintaining a happy and long life is to not fall in love. That’s fine, no problem.” The CEO: “?” 
Subordinate: “Tonight we will plot to seize power…” Su Wan: “I never stay up late, goodbye.” The male lead, who was preparing for a counterattack that night, learns that the other party is sleeping soundly: “?” 
Down-and-out big boss: “Falling into your hands is my misfortune.” Su Wan: “Aren’t you short on money? Here, take it all!” Big boss: “?” The infatuated female supporting character avoids the male lead, the big boss is casually raising a child, and the villain is doing good deeds every day… Su Wan holds a thermos cup of goji berries, smiling with a Zen-like demeanor: “Life is like a play; we meet in this life because of fate. As long as you are happy.” 
The attention of the protagonist/supporting characters/villains all falls on Su Wan, leaving them feeling empty and uncomfortable. What to do if they are not used to it! You need to perk up!
Su Wan: “Don’t advise me, there’s no outcome :)”
The female lead is a health-conscious, Zen-like charmer, while the male lead has a split personality. 
The infatuated female supporting character stops being a sycophant √
After reforming, the male lead becomes a yandere √
The villain just wants to be a good person √
I’m hoarding food and becoming a landlord in the apocalypse √
associated_names: 反派女配你支棱起来！[快穿]

93942.synopsis:
“She’s only been dead for three days, not even carried out of the house yet, and already someone comes to harm the child, thinking about the husband? How outrageous! What’s bearable and what’s not? I’ve taken over someone else’s body and become someone else’s mother, so at the very least, I should stand up for them, protect the child’s rights, win back the child’s father, witness the rightful wife come back to life, and firmly deal with the seductive mistress. What? I’m not qualified? I was brought into your home by three matchmakers and six betrothals, carried in by a grand procession with eight bearers, and worshipped at the ancestral shrine! Is it true or not? Is it true or not?”
— *Marrying the Husband for the Child*

94454.synopsis:
Xie Shuangxue is aware that he’s an NPC in a game. He exists in Shenmo, the world’s most popular VR game, which has been live for three years now. For the third-anniversary celebration, the game developer, Boundless Sea, announced a major update, introducing a new map, “Floating Dream Clouds.” Along with the update, they released a new world storyline quest—The Book of Floating Dreams. This quest unveils an ancient tale of entangled love and betrayal between a Princess of the Feather Clan and the former Demon Emperor.
And Xie Shuangxue makes his entrance in this new storyline.
He isn’t the main character; at best, he’s the fourth male lead—a mere plot device with a shallow, basic background. As an orphan adopted by the Feather Clan, he harbors an unrequited love for the princess, which eventually turns into bitterness and revenge. Betraying everyone, he ultimately meets a fitting end when the princess personally executes him, much to the players’ satisfaction.
Xie Shuangxue: … I don’t think so.
Even NPCs have their own ideas.
So, the players who are grinding away at their quests encounter, for the first time, an NPC with an unexpected level of interactivity.
When he first appeared, the players thought Xie Shuangxue was just another pretty face, gloomy, shallow, with nothing special to offer. However, as the plot unfolded, they came to understand his endless suffering, his deep and hidden love, the hardships he endured, and all the sacrifices he made in silence.
This intricate character, Xie Shuangxue, ultimately reaches a moment of enlightenment in the final segment of the world quest. Smiling, he raises a sword and takes his own life. Under the snowy night sky, his black hair dances in the wind, blood as red as cinnabar flowing like ink—the very key to unlocking the new map.
On that day, the official Shenmo account crashed under the weight of furious players.
“Damn this hellish plot! Give me back my Ah Xue!”
“WTF, you dirty devs—how dare you kill off Shuangxue!”
“I swear, if Xie Shuangxue dies, Boundless Sea, neither will you live. smile”
The game department, drenched in curses and complaints: …For heaven’s sake, this was not the original plot!
Shenmo’s development team held an emergency meeting overnight and urgently contacted the CEO of Boundless Sea. Rumor has it that even the normally calm and collected boss, who also has an account in the game, sounded noticeably different over the phone, a mix of gritted teeth and indescribable emotions.
“He’s not dead.”
“He deceived all of them.”

95734.synopsis:
A world teeming with obsessive characters.
[ The more you’re obsessed over, the stronger you become. ] 
I’ll show you the proper way to use so-called useless students.

98294.synopsis:
※ This work contains depictions of coercive relationships, including scenes involving intimacy during sleep, relationships during pregnancy, and suggestive dialogue. Reader discretion is advised. Additionally, the story’s setting is entirely fictional, and all names and places bear no connection to real-life events or individuals.
For 25 years, Eunhyun has lived an ordinary life as a Beta.
However, after starting to live with his younger brother, Yi Hyeon, whom he had been separated from for some time, Eun-hyun begins to have recurring dreams featuring his brother.
As he becomes increasingly conscious of Yi Hyeon due to the peculiar nature of these dreams, Eunhyun unexpectedly manifests as an Omega, causing their sibling relationship to take an unforeseen turn.
“Beautiful and precious things, like stars or flowers, are named by the person who discovers them. So, you’re mine. I’ll have you.”
Eun-hyun tries to dismiss his brother’s feelings as mere obsession and attempts to avoid them.
Even so, Yi Hyeon refuses to give up, persistently finding cracks in Eun-hyun’s defenses…
“I love everything about you—your body, your heart, just as they are. Even if you don’t love me back, that’s okay. Knowing you’re tolerating me, knowing you secretly wish things could go back to how they were, I still can’t stop loving you.”
Will Yi Hyeon be able to win Eun-hyun’s heart?

98806.synopsis:
“The S-level Alpha Is Pregnant!”
A black-bellied, soft-spoken, deceptive beauty who pretends to be weak (gong) VS a flirtatious playboy who firmly believes himself to be the top (shou).
Sheng Shaoyou encountered his ideal type—a delicate and alluring little white orchid named Hua Yong—at his arch-enemy’s place.
He wanted to pluck this fragile flower, place it in a vase, and keep it hidden at home. But little did he know, this seemingly “delicate white orchid” was no ordinary flower—it was a rare and noble Ghost Orchid, dark and enigmatic.
At a banquet, Sheng Shaoyou, an esteemed S-level Alpha, was drugged and assaulted as though he were an Omega. His gland was bitten and injured. Seizing the opportunity, Sheng Shaoqing, an illegitimate son who had long coveted Sheng Shaoyou’s position, struck against him.
The seemingly delicate “white orchid” silently withdrew his soft smile. The radiant and charming beauty suddenly turned sharp and sinister.
“I’ve been polite to you all this time because you’re my brother-in-law. But you dared to aim for Mr. Sheng’s life and even ruptured my gland. Though it will heal soon, it hurts a lot—”
“—So, Shaoqing, you’re in big trouble now.”

99318.synopsis:
I transmigrated into a Xianxia novel, and I accidentally made the male lead’s sword recognize me as its master.
During the war between gods and demons, the male lead swung his arm and summoned me over.
I respectfully called upon the ancient divine sword.
“Please, go help him.”
The divine sword replied, “Call me Husband, or I won’t go.”
The male lead, who was being slashed by enemies: ?

101878.synopsis:
Lu Wei transmigrated into a fantasy world rampant with demons and monsters. 
After transmigrating, he unexpectedly activated the Return System. As long as he gives gifts to beautiful women, he will receive infinite returns.
“Ding, Host gifted a low-grade medicinal pill, receiving in return 1 year of cultivation base.”
“Ding, Host gifted the ‘Basic Body Tempering Technique,’ receiving in return the ‘Dragon Elephant Subduing Prison Technique’.”
“Ding, Host gifted a hundred million children, receiving in return…”
From then on, this world gained a great benefactor, specializing in saving the wives and daughters of those with no way out. A naturally born demonic little sister, a gentle and refined sister-in-law, a graceful and elegant mother-in-law, a ruthless and beautiful boss lady, a foolishly adorable Celestial Sect prodigy, a cunning and seductive demoness…
associated_names: 逃荒路上女人是累赘？都给我

104182.synopsis:
What would you do if you had a system that could continuously simulate a cultivation world and assign you tasks?  
What if all the cultivation knowledge from the simulation was real and usable in reality, there were no penalties for failure, and you could simulate indefinitely?  
Jiang Ze chuckled.  
“Tasks? What tasks? How could tasks be more interesting than cultivating?”
In countless simulations, Jiang Ze treated himself as a player and the simulation as a dungeon, forging his own path to immortality through endless in-game deaths.  
But then, one by one, the women from the dungeon started showing up at his doorstep.  
Jiang Ze broke into a cold sweat.  
Wait… how did they escape from the simulation?!
associated_names: 完成模拟后，她们追来了！

105974.synopsis:
Xia Mingyu unexpectedly transmigrated from Blue Star to a fantasy-like medieval world, but in this world, everyone had a line of identity tags floating above their heads.  
Commoner tag: Struggle for a lifetime for a few pieces of black bread and a cramped house, toiling endlessly yet living in constant fear.  
Noble tag: Born with wealth, beauty, and the power to tear apart the law—just enjoy life to the fullest.  
King tag: I don’t eat beef.  
Having lived like a workhorse all his life, Xia Mingyu thought that even after transmigrating, he would still have to be a workhorse. But then he realized that people were already kneeling before him.  
Turns out, the tag above his head was—**Heir to a Kingdom of 1.4 Billion Citizens!**  
Xia Mingyu: “??? Wait, where did I get such a huge kingdom? Hold on… in a way, before transmigrating, wasn’t everyone technically an heir…”  
Years later, at the founding ceremony, facing the countless citizens below, the first and also last king, Xia Mingyu, spoke:  
“I have a dream—that on this land, there will no longer be serfs, prostit**es, s*aves, or any oppressed people.”  
“I have a dream—that on the ruins of what was once the capital of s*avery, the children of former s*aves and former nobles will sit side by side on the ground, as close as brothers and sisters.”  
“I have a dream—that in my country, people will no longer be judged by the tags above their heads, but by the strength of their character and morality.”  
…  
“My fellow citizens, though the road ahead is difficult and full of temptations, I ask you—lend me your strength, and let us realize these dreams together!”  
(*Note: The protagonist will send those who create prostitution to the guillotine.*)
associated_names: 十四亿国民的王国继承人

109046.synopsis:
Shinobu, an A-Class Sentinel of eastern descent uncommon in the small Kingdom of Fogness, is famous in the Indomitable Wings for detesting Guides. He’s the only member of the First Squadron without a designated Guide and furthermore, refuses to accept purification any more than necessary. That night, the rich aromas of Baileys and vodka intertwined, blue flames flickering.

[“What are these fake spouses doing here? Does the production team think the audience is blind?”] 
[“Ruan Siyi is just leeching off my queen’s fame again. Disgusting!”]

[“Is this the same arrogant nobody from before?”] 
[“The film queen never let anyone get close to her—why is she like this now…”]  
[“OMG THEY’RE SO SWEET I SHIP THEM SO HARD!!”]

Pour coffee liqueur, then layer vodka and Baileys on top—that’s a B-52 bomber.

Only Ruan Siyi knew the truth: how her high heels had once crushed the last inhibitor, her body trembling with uncontrollable desire. Long fingers swept aside her hair, baring her neck, her scent gland pulsing with temptation.  
Fu Ru’an’s voice dropped low, thick with seduction:
